notes.title: "VF5 R.E.V.O." Producer Letter #5
notes.notes: [p]Hello, I’m Seiji Aoki, producer of the "Legacy VIRTUA FIGHTER Project." [/p][p] [/p][p]I hope you’re all enjoying the "Replay Mode" feature we introduced in Ver.1.04! [/p][p]We’d love to hear any feedback and thoughts through our socials or our official Discord channel. [/p][p] [/p][p]Now on to some VIRTUA FIGHTER Open Championship (VFOC) news. Coming in hot is the deadline to register for the first of four online VFOC qualifiers on June 20th. As a reminder, these qualifiers offer a chance to compete for a spot to the Global Finals. notes.title: VF5 R.E.V.O. Producer Letter #4
notes.notes:
Greetings, I am Aoki, the producer of the Legacy VIRTUA FIGHTER Project. 

This month, we shared several significant updates during EVO Japan 2025, our VF Direct Spring 2025, and Combo Breaker 2025. How did you like them? We would love to hear your thoughts and feedback on social media, our official Discord, or directly when you see our team at upcoming events. 

I am writing this letter just after the conclusion of the North American qualifier, Combo Breaker 2025, which marks the beginning of the first ever VIRTUA FIGHTER Open Championship (VFOC). Amid the excitement in the venue and the intense energy of the players, I wanted to congratulate MGG/chinpanJ on securing a well-deserved ticket to the Global Finals! We look forward to seeing even greater achievements from you in the future. 

Now, as mentioned in a previous letter, we are pleased to announce the implementation of Replay Mode in the upcoming Ver. 1.04 update, scheduled for release soon. As previously explained, Replay Mode allows players to select and view replays of matches from both online and offline modes via the replay list. While watching a replay, you can see real-time information such as input history, command inputs, attack-related details, and frame data—similar to what appears in Free Training mode. Additionally, the update will include an option to hide the opponent’s name while viewing replays. And finally, we have added a feature that lets you take control and play from any point you choose.  

We hope players will make full use of Replay Mode to review their own fighting styles, practice combos, and work toward improving their overall skills. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to share them with us on our official Discord. 

The second destination of the VFOC, the Asia Qualifier, will be held on July 6th in Tokyo. Registration is currently open, so if you have not signed up yet, we encourage you to join the competition! 

We will also be hosting online qualifier tournaments and look forward to your participation in those as well. For more details, please visit the official VFOC website. 

See you next time at the Asia Qualifier in Tokyo! 
Thank you for your continued support of Virtua Fighter and SEGA. 

May 30, 2025 
Seiji Aoki 

Producer of the Legacy VIRTUA FIGHTER Project

notes.title: "VF5 R.E.V.O." Producer Letter #3
notes.notes:
I’m Aoki, the producer of “Legacy VIRTUA FIGHTER Project.”

Wow! Time has flown – it’s been almost three months since we released "VF5 R.E.V.O." Id like to express my sincerest gratitude to all of you streaming and holding VF tournaments and events in various countries and regions around the world.

Today starts our Golden Week Sale and brings with it our largest "VF5 R.E.V.O." discount yet, with up to 35% off – including the 30th Anniversary Edition. If you’ve been curious to see what Virtua Fighter is all about, I encourage you to take advantage of this opportunity and step into the ring!

Next, Id like to provide an update on our progress with the highly requested "Replay” feature that we are in the process of implementing. This feature will allow you to select and view replays of matches from online and offline modes. In replay mode, you can check real-time information such as input history, command inputs, attack-related information, frame data, etc. We are also exploring more ideas to enhance this feature.

Even better, you won’t have to wait long for this update. Replay Mode will be coming very soon in the not-too-distant future. Beyond this, we are checking through our Discord and social channels to see what other features you’d like to see next. We greatly appreciate your continued feedback, and I will be certain to update you on what features we come up with next.

Finally, we recently released the participation rules for the "VIRTUA FIGHTER Open Championship" (Japanese only; other languages to follow shortly). The preliminary tournaments will be conducted both online and offline in each region. For the online preliminaries, we have set regulations such as limiting participants to specific regions, so please check the guidelines to ensure your participation eligibility.

Coming up next in a few weeks will be the VF5 R.E.V.O tournament held at "EVO Japan 2025" and I am looking forward to meeting all VF fans there! Thank you again for your continued support of VF and Sega.

April 24, 2025

"Legacy VIRTUA FIGHTER Project" Producer

Seiji Aoki

Hello again, this is Seiji Aoki, the Producer of the “Legacy VIRTUA FIGHTER Project”.

Today we released the "Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O." Ver. 1.03 update. With this patch the button/key setting adjustment request that many of you asked for has been addressed. notes.title: “VF5 R.E.V.O.” Producer Letter #1
notes.notes:
Hello I’m Seiji Aoki, the Producer of the “Legacy VIRTUA FIGHTER Project.”

Today marks one month since the release of “Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O.” and we are very grateful to the many fans around the world who have picked it up and played it. We’re committed to making Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. the best experience possible and hope the latest patch, Ver.1.02 that launched two days ago, shows our dedication to this game.

Since the Open Beta in December, our development team has been reviewing your feedback, requests, and bug reports daily through our official Discord and social media accounts. While some suggestions are challenging to implement, we are constantly brainstorming ways to address them - considering their feasibility and priority level. These larger changes may take time, but we appreciate your patience and understanding. Our goal is to ensure that everyone continues to enjoy the game for a long time. We appreciate any feedback, requests or suggestions you have, and we want to hear it! So please continue to let us know us via our official Discord

We are working out the final details in preparation of our official global tournament – the "Virtua Fighter Open Championship (VFOC)," revealed during the "VF Direct 2024" stream last December and are excited to share more information with you soon. Our team is looking forward to witnessing the journey of all fighters from around the world come together in this tournament and seeing who will be crowned the first global champion of VF!

Going forward our promise to you is that we will continue sharing the latest updates about VF5 R.E.V.O., as well as the thoughts and ideas of the development team through producer letters like this one. We appreciate your continued support for VF and Sega.

2/28/2025

“Legacy VIRTUA FIGHTER Project” Producer

Seiji Aoki

notes.title: Patch UPDATE Ver. 1.02 - NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. Patch Update Ver. 1.02 is now live and brings the following:

[h3][b]Adjustments to rollback-related features and menus[/b].[/h3]

・ Removed "OFF" as an option from Options > Game Settings > Rollback (Beta)

・ Changed the values in Options > Game Settings > Frame delay (Beta) from "0-10" to "1-6".

・ When there is a difference between the player and opponent's frame delay settings during an online match, delay values for both will be adjusted to match the lower of the two.

・ Updated the guidance text that appears on the Game Settings menu for rollback-related options.

・ Effects and sound effects will not appear or play if they are inconsistent with rollback results.

[h3][b]Matchmaking adjustments[/b][/h3]

・ Adjusted the matchmaking system to prevent situations where a player would repeatedly match up with the same opponent.

[h3][b]Added basic data collection feature[/b][/h3]

・ *This is in preparation for collecting various types of data to provide a better overall gameplay experience. We plan to release statistics based on the collected data in the future, such as match-up charts and rank distribution.

[h3][b]Fixed bug where controller buttons could be assigned to keyboard and mouse if the game bar is activated by a controller[/b][/h3]

*Other bug fixes

These changes have been made possible thanks to your continued support and feedback. Please let us know any other concerns or suggestions in our discord: discord.gg/GvPrfJXHVg

notes.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O (PC) Review
notes.notes:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O is the latest updated version of the historic fighting game franchise. This release gives us a much-needed refresh as the game now supports 4k visuals, animations are smooth, and the feel of the game is everything that I remember from when the original game was released in July of 2006. With a new Virtua Fighter project on the horizon, all eyes are on this game to introduce fans to the franchise.

It’s safe to say that the fighting game community has been eating well for the last few years. Some might call it a renaissance of sorts, but at the end of the day, fighting games have steadily been gaining even more popularity among gamers worldwide, and I’m here for it. If the recent release of Marvel vs. Capcom Fighting Collection proves anything, it’s that anything is possible: like bringing back a popular game from the past and revamping it with modern features such as rollback netcode and a training mode with frame data.
